correctness.rationale: Spectral decomposition of the multipartite Laplacian into the constant, part-constant meanzero and intra-part meanzero eigenspaces yields the displayed exact kernel. Jensen positivity for α≤1 and a strictly convex transformed exponential for α>1 prove all-time and unique-cutoff sign claims. Row-sum identity proves the exact operator norm and the sign input attains it; one-derivative maximization and a factored Taylor expansion yield peak and critical coefficients. A separately assembled graph-matrix eigensystem confirms 11,556 finite numerical assertions; these tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: A natural one-parameter family of fractional heat flows changes from positivity-preserving to only eventually positive at an explicit sharp exponent. The novel quantitative feature is the separation of first-order positivity delay and second-order peak norm amplification, with positive computable coefficients for every finite complete multipartite part profile. These measure distinguishable, mathematically natural stability properties not supplied by general positivity criteria.
